StudioHenge

We’re a game company inspired by an earlier era of computing, when limitations encouraged invention, worlds kept their secrets, and progress had to be earned.

Expect less monetization and more respect for the player.

01OUR DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Transporting players
somewhere else.

Follow the river beyond old stone bridges, through distant fields, and down roads that vanish over the hills. What waits beyond is ours: original stories, places, and histories written for the world they inhabit.

We aren't interested in modern people dressed in medieval clothes. Our worlds belong to another time, with different customs, ambitions, virtues, and vices. Expect human stories of love and war, faith and betrayal, revelry and ruin.

A GLIMPSE OF THE WORLDEvery path begins somewhere.
✧I /

Places have reasons

A bridge brings grain to market and tolls to whoever controls the crossing. That one detail can explain a town's wealth, politics, and enemies.

◇II /

The land has a say

A forest can hide an army, a marsh can swallow a road, and a pass can save days or cost lives. Terrain changes the choices players make.

✺III /

Life beyond the quest

A smith has customers, a priest has doubts, and neighbours keep old grudges. Their lives should make sense even if the player walks past.

02HOW WE FUND THE WORK

A culture
of support.

We plan to keep monetization light and ask for support plainly. Optional memberships, much like Patreon, would let people who care about Henge help fund its ongoing development. That support gives us time to build the world carefully without turning every moment of play into a sales opportunity.

We want to earn that support by showing our work. Notes and dev diaries will share what we’re making and why. Membership should sustain the studio; progress in the game should still come from curiosity, effort, and time spent in the world.
